questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All bongos are sitars.

No cymbal is a sitar.

Conclusions:

[1] All sitars are bongos.

[2] Some bongos are cymbals.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b132807128d166b6e7b1f598205340055af622cbca221d9924cbd17f936a559.png] 

Conclusions:

[1] All sitars are bongos → Does not follow (As all bongos are sitars. So it is possible but not definite.)

[2] Some bongos are cymbals → Does not follow (As all bongos are sitars and no cymbal is a sitar. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion [1] nor [2] follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: Seven people R, S, T, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). G is sitting second to the right of E. Only one person is sitting between G and R. Only one person is sitting between R and T. F is sitting second to the left of D. D is an immediate neighbour of T. How many people are sitting between S and T when counted from the left of S?
questions.solution:
Given:

Seven people R, S, T, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) G is sitting second to the right of E.

2) Only one person is sitting between G and R.

3) Only one person is sitting between R and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cd58d1734e65845fce5929ac872c25053f1ed8dac419ee831dc8bc6161e5a04.png] 

4) F is sitting second to the left of D.

5) D is an immediate neighbour of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/609e85eaeed7ba33c7e9a4d1e12c4e6ff6575ee09629da26256a763f73543a1a.png] 

So, 'One' people are sitting between S and T when counted from the left of S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)".**

questions.solution: The logic followed here is: 12 is related to 61 __**12 × 5**__ + 1 = 61 __**60 + 1**__ = 61 61 = 61 (LHS = RHS) And, 15 is related to 76 __15 × 5__ + 1 = 76

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All crocs are frogs.

All crocs are turtles.

Conclusions:

(i) All turtles are frogs.

(ii) At least some frogs are crocs.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ff9b785a64b4abc914724efbf592545fd71ca7567568f8966760d16a107636f.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) All turtles are frogs → Does not follow (As all crocs are frogs and all crocs are turtles. So it is possible but not definite.)

(ii) At least some frogs are crocs → **F**ollow (As all crocs are turtles. As whole crocs comes in turtles, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (ii) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
